content: CloudKit is strongly consistent for fetch-by-recordID but eventually consistent for queries: after CKModifyRecordsOperation returns, record search indexes take time to converge, so queries (and the iCloud Console) may still show deleted records; CKModifyRecordsOperation.h states the completion fires as soon as the server has seen all changes while side-effect processing continues. Apple dev forums report iCloud Console deletion propagation observed slow in practice. DATA-01 evidence must record the observed propagation delay before query-based emptiness is judged.
